main_text.l: HIc locus effet submonendi lectorem de
Erratis in dictione, seu meis, seu Ty-
pographi, quæ oculos meos fugerunt; ut sunt
in Epistolis pag.53. l. 4. Donzel pro Denzel
& p. 197. in titulo, ubi lege Ludovico Heraldo
S. S. Theologiæ Doctori, Ecclesiæ, &c. Et p. 288. l. 8. sentiunt pro sentiant: nam eâ-[?] p. 288. l. 8. jentiunt
pro jentiant. Item eadem paginâ l. 22. legendum, que jusqu'a ce & l. 24. delendum, il croira, & legendum, je
croiray. In Admonitione. p. 7. l. 2. lege
lege qualis. Sed pleraque indicavi & correxi ad

page.notes: The last line is cut off at the bottom of the scan and continues in part 2. The large initial H is read as H with [?] not needed. The handwritten "180" at top right is manuscript and not transcribed. The scan shows a short horizontal rule and some specks, which are not text. Some letters in the first line are cut off at the top edge. The ligatures and long s have been written as plain s. The first line is a fragment ("p. 288. l. 8.") and has been kept as printed.
